title: A suite test pins check.py's lexical code scan on its edge cases: prefixed, concatenated, nested and one-line docstrings, f-strings, header comments
goal: A test in test_check_programs.py runs code_comment_lines on a planted file of the scan's edge cases (string prefixes, concatenated and one-line docstrings, f-strings holding #, comments in a def header) and asserts the comment and docstring lines ast and tokenize would give, within the test ceiling
